subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should #88204 stay as the umbrella tracker while maintainers split the TUI, sessions_send, WeChat plugin-boundary, background-event isolation, and meaningful-activity work into owner-scoped items?
rationale: The current source gaps are real, but one automated patch cannot safely choose the TUI default route, sessions_send fix layer, WeChat plugin/core boundary, and background-event activity model.

options.title: Split and route subproblems
options.body: Keep this issue open until focused issues or PRs own each remaining behavior, with #93255 and #51028 covering their narrower parts.

options.title: Keep one human-owned umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as the maintainer-owned tracker and block automation until the WeChat and flood/deadlock paths are reproduced live.

options.title: Close only after linked proof
options.body: Close this issue only after focused linked fixes or explicit decisions cover every reported behavior with current-main proof.

recommendation.title: Split and route subproblems
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until focused issues or PRs own each remaining behavior, with #93255 and #51028 covering their narrower parts.
